steps.title: Next.js 앱 + Supabase 클라이언트 셋업
steps.prompt: Scaffold a Next.js (App Router, TypeScript) app if not present. Add @supabase/supabase-js and @supabase/ssr. Create a typed Supabase browser client and a server client. Read the project URL and anon key from environment variables only — never hard-code them.
steps.done: Supabase clients compile and reference env vars, not literals.

steps.title: 환경변수 정리
steps.prompt: Create `.env.example` with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. Ensure real .env* files are gitignored.

steps.title: 로그인 / 회원가입 UI
steps.prompt: Build login and signup forms (email + password) using the Supabase client. Handle loading and error states. Do not trust unvalidated input.
steps.done: Auth pages render and the production build passes.

steps.title: 세션 미들웨어 + 보호 라우트
steps.prompt: Add middleware that refreshes the Supabase session and protects an authenticated route group, redirecting unauthenticated users to /login.
steps.done: Protected routes redirect when logged out.

steps.title: RLS 정책 적용
steps.prompt: Create a `profiles` table keyed by auth.uid(). Enable Row Level Security and add policies so each user can read/write only their own row. Document the SQL in the repo.
steps.done: RLS is enabled and policies restrict access to the row owner.
